description: Use this when the user wants to stop the running timer and save the time entry. It needs no timer_status call first: if no timer is running, the result says so. The timer stops now unless `endDateTime` gives another time.

description.description: What the user worked on, saved as the description of the entry. Leave it out to keep the description the timer has.

endDateTime.description: Optional end time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2025-10-08T18:00:00Z"). If not provided, uses current time.

name: timer_stop

duration.description: Duration of the running task in seconds

pause.description: The current break, while the timer is paused

task.description: The running task, with its project. Absent when no timer runs.

title: Stop Timer
